        Settings

        Appearance

        Theme
        Accent color
        Second accent
        Blends with the first, like the album-art colours. The crossed-out swatch uses one colour.
        Track list density
        Match accent to album art
        Picks colours from the current cover. Falls back to your accent colours.
        App name
        Shown in the title bar and on the taskbar. Leave empty for the default. You can also right-click the name in the title bar.
        Custom CSS
        Your own styling on top of the theme.
        Edit custom CSS
        Applied as you type.

        Integrations

        SoundCloud
        Not signed in.
        Last.fm
        Not signed in. Needs lastfm_api_key and lastfm_secret in config.json.
        Last.fm options
        Scrobble plays
        Sends what you play to Last.fm.
        Spotify
        Not signed in. Spotify only appears once you sign in with a Premium account.
        Spotify options
        Spotify playback
        Local music
        Your own music files, from folders on this PC or a network drive.
        Music folders

        Output Preferences

        Discord Rich Presence
        Shows the track you're currently listening to as your Discord activity.
        Now playing widget
        A now-playing card for OBS or other streaming software. It only shows what's playing; it doesn't play audio.
        Widget options
        In OBS: add a Browser Source with this address. Any size works; it scales to fit.
        Text size
        100%
        Animations
        Colour change speed
        Chat song requests
        Lets a chat bot add tracks to your queue, from whichever platform is selected in the title bar.
        Song request options
        Chat bot

        Limits and waiting requests
        Most requests waiting at once
        10
        Most requests per viewer
        2
        Waiting requests
        None.
        Chat messages

        What the bot posts. You can use {title}, {artist}, {user}, {position}, {platform}, {query} and {count}.

        Connection
        Port
        Secret key
        Part of the request address. Only requests with it are accepted; make a new one if it leaks.

        Audio

        Even out loudness
        Brings quiet tracks up and loud ones down, like a leveling compressor.
        Equalizer
        Ten bands, for everything the app plays. Changes are heard straight away.
        Equalizer bands

        Used for everything the app plays, Spotify included.

        Performance

        Hardware acceleration
        Draws the app with your GPU. Turn it off if you see glitches or want to avoid GPU memory use. It may raise CPU use slightly.

        Restart SC Client to apply this.

        Animations
        Colour fades, cover fades and other motion in the app. Long titles still scroll when you hover them. The widget has its own animation options.
        Close button hides to the tray
        Music keeps playing. Quit from the tray icon's menu.
